originalText:
第2章 
之前或许是因为初雪的关系，陈启从来没有发现这个平原上竟然有如此多的生物。短短一个上午他就看见了一群数百头数量的象群和羚羊群经过，还有一条手腕粗的蟒蛇躲在草丛中试图袭击陈启，被阿泽眼疾手快地掐断了脖子扔到了一边，瞬间就被两只不知道什么时候埋伏在旁边的胡狼叼走了。
陈启吓出一身白毛汗，不停给自己做心理建设才不至于腿软。
其实有阿泽在身边，在多拉平原上就算是遇到整群的狮群两人也能全身而退，多拉平原上的生物遇到兽人大多都会远远躲开，他们知道兽人可是比狮子还要危险的存在。
对于兽人来说，真正的危险是来自洛雅森林。
多拉平原上的生物并不能满足兽人们的生活需求，它们或许今年出现在多拉平原上，但初雪后，所有的大型生物，包括狮子和狼群都会跟随迁徙大军一直往南走。
慢慢习惯后陈启发现，除了蛇这种会主动袭击人的动物之外，其他动物根本不会靠近他们两个人身边，不久前他还看到一只猎豹发现他们过来，远远就带着两只小猎豹钻进了一旁的高草丛中。
在多拉平原，植物远远比动物危险的多。
在不知道第几次被藤蔓绊倒并试图将他拉走后，陈启火了，在阿泽将捆着他脚裸的藤蔓撕成两段后，陈启拿起一块石头将那截还在挪动的部分砸的稀巴烂，完了还从口袋里摸出一个打火机将那藤蔓烧成灰烬。
阿泽还是第一次看见那么暴躁的雄子，看对方盯着已经熄灭的灰烬由不解气，提议道：“这一片是食人藤的领地，它们习惯躲在草丛中伏击猎物，如果你不介意的话我可以背着你走，我速度很快。”
translatedText:
Chapter 2

Perhaps it was because of the first snow earlier, but Chen Qi had never realized just how much life there was on this plain. In just a single morning, he saw herds of hundreds of elephants and antelopes passing by. A python as thick as a wrist, hiding in the grass, tried to ambush him, only for A Ze to swiftly snap its neck and toss it aside. In the blink of an eye, two jackals that had been lurking nearby snatched it away.

Chen Qi broke out in a cold sweat, constantly psyching himself up just to keep his knees from buckling.

In truth, with A Ze by his side, they could walk away unscathed on the Dora Plains even if they crossed paths with an entire pride of lions. Most creatures on the Dora Plains gave beastmen a wide berth; they knew beastmen were far deadlier than lions.

For beastmen, the true danger came from the Loya Forest.

The wildlife on the Dora Plains could not sustain the beastmen's livelihood. While animals might appear on the plains this year, once the first snow fell, all large creatures—including lions and packs of wolves—would join the great migration south.

As he gradually grew accustomed to his surroundings, Chen Qi noticed that aside from creatures like snakes that actively attacked people, other animals avoided them entirely. Just a short while earlier, he had watched a cheetah spot their approach from afar, hurriedly ushering her two cubs into the tall grass to hide.

On the Dora Plains, plants were far more dangerous than animals.

After being tripped and dragged away by vines for who knew how many times, Chen Qi finally lost his temper. Once A Ze ripped the vine wrapped around his ankle in two, Chen Qi seized a rock and smashed the squirming remnant into a mangled pulp. Afterward, he pulled a lighter from his pocket and burned the remains to ashes.

It was the first time A Ze had ever seen such an irritable male. Watching him still glare furiously at the extinguished ashes, A Ze suggested, "This area is the territory of man-eating vines. They're used to lying in wait in the grass to ambush prey. If you don't mind, I can carry you on my back. I'm very fast."
